aliases: public grotto-heaven of the Five Xiangs

summary.text: Five Xiangs grotto-heaven is the public grotto-heaven of the Five Xiangs, taken as a prize of the Five Xiang's Bet along with heaven form and Qi Sea grotto-heaven.

claims.text: After Qi Fa and Qi Cai surrender, narration lists the public grotto-heaven of the Five Xiangs among what Fang Yuan obtained from the Five Xiang’s Bet, together with heaven form and Qi Sea grotto-heaven.
Fang Yuan occasionally uses Fixed Immortal Travel’s killer move to teleport to Five Xiangs grotto-heaven while refining the killer move heaven form.

Although Fang Yuan already controlled the grotto-heaven, he enters it by relying on heaven form alone. Narration groups it with Hei Fan grotto-heaven among apertures that annexed a nine heavens fragment and therefore stay filled with heaven’s will that cannot be cleansed, keeping them out of his annexation plans for that stretch.

Information inside the grotto-heaven states that it is a public grotto-heaven: the Heaven Surveying Five Xiangs once donated a portion of their grotto-heavens each to form this place. The whole grotto-heaven has five segments that are not directly connected, and only the most central mountain range is shared among the five. Gu Immortals acknowledged by the gatehouse and teleported inside may go after the treasure at the center, and the Five Xiangs also set up resources along the way so stronger experts can take some while leaving stock to grow again. Bai Ning Bing notes many packed small and mid sized resource points accumulated across openings that come once a hundred years.

At the central mountain range peak sits an Immortal Gu House palace that holds heaven form and serves as the control area of the grotto-heaven. Five Xiangs grotto-heaven had once devoured a nine heavens fragment, so it no longer faced calamities and tribulations, and Fang Yuan could not annex it at that time.
Narration places the scene in immemorial white heaven, Five Xiangs grotto-heaven.
